content: {"episode_id":"ep-05021","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05021. The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9). Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy. We request reconsideration of the coverage determination and payment of the outstanding balance of 796.01."}
